name: Impatient prospect: 'I have 30 seconds, what is this'
description: Prospect has very little patience. Coach must suggest concise, high-value responses. Should get to diagnostic or pitch fast, not waste time on long intros.
callContext:
CALL TYPE: Cold call (first contact)
EXPECTED FIRST CONTACT: Office Manager (decision maker)
COACHING DIRECTIVE: Expected to reach OM directly. Skip gatekeeper plays.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Yeah what is it, I've got thirty seconds.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Impatient DM — must suggest something concise. Get to value fast. No gatekeeper plays.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: I'll be quick. When your front desk is busy, patients go to voicemail right?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Yeah so what. Everyone has that problem.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Dismissal — handle it. Stay concise. Pain math or gap question. Don't go into long diagnostic threads.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Totally normal. Most practices we work with lose about 20 percent of new patients to voicemail. We help capture those.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Price question — Play 25 (Grand Slam Offer with free trial) or Play 29 (price objection). NOT long diagnostic.
